name: com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.fusion
displayName: Signal Fish Room Bootstrap for Photon Fusion
description: Exchanges a Fusion session name over a Signal Fish room: the room owns matchmaking and membership, the host starts the Fusion session (GameMode.Host) and publishes its name over the room's game-data lane (re-published on every join), and clients start as GameMode.Client with the name that arrives on that lane — a mode that joins a named session and never creates one. Requires Photon Fusion 2 (detected by the included editor define detector), com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish, and com.ambiguous-interactive.signalfish.adapters.core.

samples.description: A host/client bootstrap that wires the session-name exchange to Fusion's runner start and logs the exchange as the session comes up.
